title: WRRA Neuropsychology: Exploring WRRA's Potential for Integration Across Disciplines — Core 2.1 Consciousness Extension, Korean and English v0.10
description: Complete Korean (205 pages) and English (189 pages) v0.10 manuscripts: twelve parts and 54 chapters each. Nine consciousness chapters and Appendix A12 apply Core 2.1 while preserving earlier Core 1.0 computations. W3–W5 and R71–R89 credit original research and author manuscripts. Scientific evidence, explanatory specifications and philosophical extension questions are distinguished. No new empirical validation or Astra review is claimed.
